theme.name: rangergreen
theme.label: RangerGreen
theme.source: Interpretation of a digital investing brand: mint green, charcoal and a serif display face
theme.disclaimer: An independent visual interpretation created by the author for portfolio purposes. Not an official source and not affiliated with or endorsed by any company. Values are adapted, not reproduced.

typography.note: heading and label use the display family. weights[role] drives font-weight and font-style for that role.

background.description: Surface colors for page, containers, layers, and interactive states. Use for fills behind content, not for text or borders.

layer.description: Secondary layered area within a surface.

accent.description: Subtle translucent tint overlay (black at ~5% in light, white at ~5% in dark).

primary.description: Solid primary brand background for emphasis areas.

secondary.description: Secondary brand background for supporting emphasis areas.

promotional.description: Deepest brand background for banners and promotional areas.

hover.description: Background shown when a surface or item is hovered.

active.description: Background shown when a surface or item is pressed or selected.

disabled.description: Background for disabled controls and areas.

surface.description: Cards and raised containers on the base background.

content.description: Text and icon foreground colors. 'default' for body text, 'strong' for headings and emphasis, 'subtle' for secondary text, 'disabled' for inactive content, and 'on-dark' or 'on-light' when text sits on a contrasting background.

disabled.description: Text and icons on disabled controls (translucent).

onDark.description: Text on dark or saturated backgrounds.

onLight.description: Text on light or pale-tinted backgrounds, including light solid status fills.

brand.description: Core accent palette: primary blue family, navy secondary, and yellow tertiary. Brand values are the same in both variants.

primary.description: Primary brand colour. Used for links, active borders, and emphasis.

tertiaryTint.description: Very light tint of the tertiary colour for highlight backgrounds.

tertiaryShade.description: Darker shade of the tertiary colour.

gradient.description: Brand gradient from mint 600 to mint 800.

status.description: Status colors. 'critical' is error (red), 'alert' is notification (yellow). Each status has a solid background, a subtle background, a border, and a content accent. Dark variant uses deeper fills and lighter accents.

backgroundSubtle.description: Light success tint for banners and containers.
Light error tint for banners and containers.
Light info tint for banners and containers.
Light warning tint for banners and containers.
Light notification tint for banners and containers.

border.description: Outline and divider colors for inputs, cards, dividers, and focus states.

active.description: Border for focused or selected items.

inverse.description: Border used on dark or saturated surfaces.

default.description: Standard border for inputs and cards.

link.description: Hyperlink colors for default, hover, destructive, and inverse contexts.

inverseDefault.description: Link text on dark or saturated backgrounds.

accent.description: Accent role used for emphasis text, fills and borders. Falls back to the brand colour in themes that have no separate accent.

highlightFill.description: Marker fill behind highlighted words. Transparent in themes and modes with no marker.

highlightText.description: Text colour of highlighted words, readable on the highlight fill.

content.description: Extra foreground roles that sit outside the 60-token contract.

onAccent.description: Text and icons on an accent fill.

background.description: Extra background roles that sit outside the 60-token contract.

inverse.description: Inverse page background (dark on light themes, light on dark).

overlayTransparent.description: Translucent overlay behind modals and sheets.

border.description: Extra border roles that sit outside the 60-token contract.

data.description: Data visualisation roles for chart and timeline bars. Kept apart from accent so buttons and links can change independently.

primary.description: Primary data mark: chart bars and timeline bars.

secondary.description: Secondary data mark: second chart series and faded timeline segments.

risk.description: Ten-step risk scale used by the RangerGreen theme (low to high).

corePalette.description: Raw colour scale for this theme, named {hue}-{step} (050 to 900, optional 950). Values do not change between modes. Semantic tokens reference these.
